verdict.line: You lose if you stand in Frenzied Maul range for the second cast; you win if you force Volibear to burn Thundering Smash early and punish with Jousting resets.

brief.thesis: Volibear's entire trade pattern is W (Frenzied Maul) stacking into a second cast that heals him, so the matchup is decided by whether you can hit-and-run with E (Jousting) before he lands that second W. The 50% win rate over 78 games reflects an even lane where both sides have kill pressure but Kled's dash threat lets him dictate when trades happen.

tell.watch: Volibear's W mark duration on you

theirWindow.when: after he lands first Frenzied Maul mark
theirWindow.what: He has roughly 1-2 seconds to re-cast W for bonus damage and healing. If you stay in his 325 range during this window you eat the full combo.

yourWindow.when: right after his Q or E lands on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Thundering Smash (12-10s) and Sky Splitter (16s) are his only engage/poke tools. The instant either whiffs or lands, jump in with Q (Bear Trap) to hook and yank him, then E (Jousting) through for the double-hit before he can reset W.

boots.why: Taken in 50.6% of games at 60% win rate; the tenacity shortens how long Thundering Smash's stun locks you in Frenzied Maul range.

if the lane is going even and you want to push waves and split faster than Volibear can punish

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in both top rune pages (24.3% and 10.7% pick); the stacking adaptive force and healing on fully stacked keeps you ahead in the extended trades this matchup demands.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 77.7% of games at 48.8% win rate; Ignite punishes Volibear's W healing by cutting it, which directly answers his main sustain tool in this lane.

playing.title: Hook before he stacks W
playing.detail: Throw Q (Bear Trap) the moment he's in range rather than waiting. Yanking him in early denies the setup for his second Frenzied Maul cast.

playing.title: Joust out after his Q lands
playing.detail: The instant Thundering Smash connects and he's used his stun, E (Jousting) away. His only other gap-closer is a 300-range Q on a 10-12s cooldown, so you're safe to disengage.

playing.title: Pop W during his W mark window
playing.detail: If he marks you with Frenzied Maul and you can't retreat, trigger Violent Tendencies immediately. The attack speed burst outraces his bonus-damage second cast in raw DPS.

playing.title: Track Sky Splitter cooldown for all-ins
playing.detail: Sky Splitter is 16s and the only ranged poke he has. Once it's down, close distance and all-in; he has no way to re-create range before your Q and E land.

playing.title: Save Jousting for his R landing
playing.detail: Stormbringer disables towers near his landing spot and gives him bonus health, so don't contest him directly. Instead dash in with E once his shield from Sky Splitter is gone to punish the health bonus before it matters.

playing.title: Trade off cooldown, not on sight
playing.detail: Because this is a near-even 50% matchup, avoid trading on his terms when his W is off cooldown (5s base). Wait for a window where his Q, E, and W are all down before committing.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Keep some distance from Volibear to avoid his Sky Splitter (E) and Thundering Smash (Q). Use Jousting [E], Bear Trap on a Rope [Q], and Violent Tendencies [W] to deal damage while avoiding the second strike on Frenzied Maul (W) by retreating using Jousting [E].
